name: anymodel-subagents
description: Subagents for Claude Code that run on outside models (OpenRouter first). Push token-heavy reading, searching, editing and test-writing to cheap models; keep this session for architecture and review.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Used only to authenticate worker requests to OpenRouter; never sent anywhere else. Create a dedicated key for this plugin (openrouter.ai/keys) with a credit limit, and turn on Zero Data Retention in your OpenRouter privacy settings (openrouter.ai/settings/privacy) so worker prompts and completions aren't retained or used for training. Stored in your OS keychain, not in settings.json.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API key
brave_api_key.description: Used only for worker web search (the web-researcher role), via the Brave Search API. Brave retains query records for up to 90 days for billing and troubleshooting. Also requires web_enabled: true in config.yaml. Leave unset to keep web access off. Stored in your OS keychain, not in settings.json.

jina_api_key.title: Jina Reader API key
jina_api_key.description: Used only for worker web page fetch (the web-researcher role), via Jina Reader. Requests are sent with DNT so Jina does not cache or log them. Optional: fetch works keyless at a lower rate limit. Stored in your OS keychain, not in settings.json.

openrouter_region_url.title: OpenRouter endpoint (optional)
openrouter_region_url.description: Leave blank for the global endpoint. Set https://us.openrouter.ai/api/v1 or https://eu.openrouter.ai/api/v1 if your OpenRouter account requires a regional endpoint. openrouter_base_url in config.yaml, if set, takes precedence.

worker_model.title: Worker model for all roles (optional)
worker_model.description: An OpenRouter model id (for example z-ai/glm-5.3-flash) used by every worker role. Leave blank to use each role's own model. Per-role choices go in config.yaml under role_models, and override this for the roles they name. Run list_workers with include_models to see ZDR models that support tool calls.
